native_refinement.method: Original lower-right gold endpoints are continuously fitted over nineteen native rows for ownership only, then a six-native-pixel closed-form colour edge solve follows the original photograph. This replaces the hard row endpoint clipping of the prior private trial. Original RGB and original gilt texture remain untouched; no upscaling, new gilt, or shape redraw. Exterior flowers/paper are excluded, original scene and entire visible golden rim retained.

Native source gold rim measured along the inspected lower-right boundary: near the manually inspected source silhouette, rightmost contiguous gold pigment (>=5 native pixels) establishes the paint endpoint. Nine-row ownership median only removes isolated paper/floral flecks; the actual original paint RGB is unchanged. Two native pixels retain the dark outer contour before three-pixel edge matting. Exterior paper and adjacent red flower excluded, complete original gold rim and landscape opaque.

Complete original gilded oval follows source perimeter landmarks read from the native coordinate grid, including the asymmetric lower-right curvature. Eight-native-pixel continuous edge matting preserves the actual original gilt contour and paint transitions. Full original landscape is opaque; manuscript flora/paper outside excluded. No RGB or anatomy redraw or source resize.

Original gilded oval exterior follows individually inspected source boundary landmarks, with a twelve-native-pixel closed-form edge solve matching actual paint/paper transitions. Continuous spline is ownership only, not a redrawn golden ellipse. Whole original landscape and original gold perimeter are opaque. No source scaling, smoothing of original RGB or alteration of anatomy. Both earlier automatic candidates rejected for cutting the gold rim or admitting neighboring floral paint.

Whole original painted landscape oval: source blue/gold pigment establishes its actual perimeter, with complete interior scene opaque. Largest source pigment island filled through the landscape; ellipse is only a loose exterior exclusion, never a drawn perimeter. Initial GrabCut candidate cutting the original gold rim rejected. Three-native-pixel continuous edge alpha, native original RGB unscaled.

Original oval painted scene is opaque. Ellipse only seeds native foreground/background ownership; native source pigment boundaries determine the actual irregular perimeter. GrabCut and three-native-pixel closed-form edge matting; no geometric oval is redrawn. Interior lettering belongs to the original painted scene and is retained. Exterior manuscript parchment, berries and flowers excluded.
